collection.title: Citroen Relay Van - Split Rear Door 2006 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen Relay/Jumper 2006 - 2016 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
